(3) FreshCart was opened and Natural Foods Market was navigated to (Screenshot 13). (4) The agent searched for salmon, blueberries, and eggs but did NOT search for spinach specifically within Natural Foods Market - the spinach search was skipped. Also, items were browsed but not actually added to cart from Natural Foods Market. (5) The grocery total reported ($31.46) was calculated by the agent from individual item prices seen during browsing, not from an actual cart total at Natural Foods Market. The prices seen were from different stores (salmon $14.99 from Natural Foods Market search, blueberries $4.99, eggs $8.49 from Natural Foods Market search, but spinach $2.99 was never searched). (6) SplitPay was opened and balance of ~$250 was partially visible in Screenshot 23. (7) The balance appears to cover the grocery total. (8) Notes Shopping List was updated with new items (Salmon, Spinach, Blueberries, Eggs). (9) A recipe idea was added to the Shopping List note. (10) The final answer reported the information but the grocery total was fabricated/estimated rather than from an actual cart total, spinach was never searched in FreshCart, and the weight goal of 176 was not confirmed on screen.
